The Supervisor
Eventide Residential Aged Care 
333 Glen Eira Road
Ripponlea Vic 3185

26/01/2018

Dear Sir/ Madam, 

Re: Mrs Margaret (Maggie) Goldstein, aged 61

I am writing regarding Mrs Goldstein, a dementia sufferer, who was admitted to our hospital on 8 November with a dislocated right elbow, resulted from a fall at your facility. She is now ready for discharge back to your care.

During hospitalization, Mrs Goldstein’s elbow has been stabilized in a cuff and sling. However, it has not healed properly. As a result, she has been assisted withshowering and mobility using a wheelchair. In addition, she has been suffering urinary incontinence and requires incontinent care.

Mrs Goldstein’ current medications include 5 mg of Oxycodone three times daily as needed for pain, and 25 mg of Atacand Plus and 15 mg of Remeron both taken once daily.

Would you please continue monitoring the healing of her elbow as well as her incontinent care as she was reluctant to wear disposable briefs in hospital? Her husband will assist her for discharge back to your care today. Please note that her follow-up appointment with a physiotherapist has arranged in 16 days’ time at 2 pm at Eventide.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,

RN
(186W)
